title: Blacked-out bus ride south to S-4

tellings.quote: long bumpy ride. Um And that the windows were blacked out on the bus.

plain: Around 1988 and 1989, workers were driven from Area 51, the secret Air Force test base in Nevada, south to a hidden site called S-4 on a bus whose windows were blacked out, over a "long bumpy ride". Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, describes the trip from his own experience. The blacked-out windows, as he tells it, kept workers from knowing exactly where they were going.
